notes: The opening *When* answers to no morpheme and is `added` under rule 55; the waw of `וְהָאֲנָשִׁים` opens the following clause and is left unrendered (rule 14).
The second `אֲשֶׁר` is unrepresented, since the ASV writes only *near to* for that clause (rule 22), and `עִם` takes the compound *near to* headed on *near* (rule 24).
`הִרְחִיקוּ` → *were a good way* writes no word for the verb's own lexeme, so the head goes to the content word the phrase turns on (rule 24).
